info.name: Vultax — Public Research and Vi IQ Developer Preview
info.description:
Public research discovery works now without a key. The Vi IQ gateway requests run against the local developer preview until production marketplace launch is verified. Gateway implementation and launch package. Production marketplace access is pending publisher setup and the dedicated IQ reader connection. Scores are source-reported proprietary metrics, not forecasts. See metadata for actual coverage and timestamps.

Start the local gateway with npm start. Set apiToken in a private environment, never publish a token. Production URLs will be added only after verification. Vultax: https://vultax.com/methodology
